# GeeksforGeeks

> GeeksforGeeks is an all-in-one learning portal for computer science, programming, interview preparation, and technical practice.

It offers tutorials, courses, coding problems, interview resources, and topic-wise learning paths across data structures, algorithms, programming languages, web development, AI/ML, and core computer science subjects.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/): Main portal for tutorials, practice, courses, and technical learning resources.
- [Explore](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/explore): Discovery hub for trending tutorials, topic collections, and learning resources.
- [Courses](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses): Catalog of self-paced and guided courses across programming and computer science.
- [Practice](https://practice.geeksforgeeks.org/): Coding practice platform with problems, contests, and interview-focused exercises.
- [Jobs](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/jobs): Technical hiring and job-related resources for students and professionals.
- [Campus](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/campus): Campus-focused learning and placement preparation resources.
- [Puzzles](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzles/): Collection of logical, mathematical, and interview puzzle articles.

## Data Structures and Algorithms
- [DSA Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/dsa-tutorial-learn-data-structures-and-algorithms/): Structured introduction to core data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving techniques.
- [Learn DSA](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/learn-data-structures-and-algorithms-dsa-tutorial/): Beginner-friendly DSA roadmap for interview preparation and fundamentals.
- [Arrays](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/array-data-structure-guide/): Articles and examples covering array concepts, operations, and common problems.
- [Linked List](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/data-structures/linked-list/): Tutorials on singly, doubly, and circular linked lists with implementations.
- [Stack Data Structure](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/stack-data-structure/): Stack concepts, operations, applications, and implementation approaches.
- [Queue Data Structure](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/queue-data-structure/): Queue basics, variants, and practical algorithmic applications.
- [Tree Data Structure](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/binary-tree-data-structure/): Binary tree concepts, traversals, and related problem-solving resources.
- [Graph Data Structure and Algorithms](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/graph-data-structure-and-algorithms/): Graph representations, traversals, shortest paths, and graph problems.

## Algorithms and Problem Solving
- [Searching Algorithms](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/searching-algorithms/): Linear, binary, and advanced searching methods with examples.
- [Sorting Algorithms](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/sorting-algorithms/): Comparison and non-comparison sorting techniques with implementations.
- [Dynamic Programming](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dynamic-programming/): DP concepts, patterns, and classic optimization problems.
- [Greedy Algorithms](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/greedy-algorithms/): Greedy strategy tutorials with standard interview examples.
- [Backtracking](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/backtracking-algorithms/): Recursive search techniques for combinatorial and constraint problems.
- [Recursion](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/recursion/): Recursive thinking, examples, and common recursion-based problems.
- [Divide and Conquer](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/divide-and-conquer-algorithm-introduction/): Core divide-and-conquer ideas and representative algorithms.
- [Pattern Searching](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/pattern-searching/): String matching algorithms and related text-processing techniques.

## Programming Languages
- [Python Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-programming-language-tutorial/): Python basics, syntax, OOP, libraries, and practical examples.
- [Java Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java/java/): Java language fundamentals, OOP, collections, and platform concepts.
- [C Programming Language](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/c/c-programming-language/): C syntax, memory, pointers, and procedural programming basics.
- [C++ Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/c-plus-plus/): C++ fundamentals, STL, OOP, and competitive programming topics.
- [JavaScript Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/javascript-tutorial/): JavaScript language concepts for frontend and general programming.
- [PHP Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/php/php-tutorial/): PHP syntax, server-side scripting, and web programming basics.
- [Go Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/go-language/introduction-to-go-programming-language/): Introduction to Go syntax, concurrency, and language features.
- [Rust Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/rust/rust-tutorial/): Rust ownership, safety, syntax, and systems programming concepts.

## Web Development
- [HTML Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/html/html-tutorial/): HTML elements, structure, forms, and semantic markup basics.
- [CSS Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/css/css-tutorial/): CSS styling, layout, selectors, and responsive design fundamentals.
- [JavaScript for Web](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/javascript-tutorial/): JavaScript essentials commonly used in interactive web development.
- [React Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/reactjs/reactjs-tutorials/): React components, hooks, state, and frontend application development.
- [Node.js Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/node-js/nodejs/): Node.js runtime basics, modules, and backend JavaScript development.
- [Express.js Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/web-tech/express-js/): Express concepts for routing, middleware, and API development.
- [Bootstrap Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/bootstrap/bootstrap-tutorial/): Bootstrap components and responsive UI development basics.
- [Web Development](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/web-development/): Broader web development articles, roadmaps, and technology guides.

## Computer Science Fundamentals
- [DBMS](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dbms/): Database concepts, normalization, SQL, transactions, and DBMS theory.
- [Operating Systems](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/operating-systems/): OS concepts including processes, scheduling, memory, and synchronization.
- [Computer Networks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/computer-network-tutorials/): Networking fundamentals, protocols, models, and communication concepts.
- [OOPs Concepts](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/object-oriented-programming-oops-concept-in-java/): Core object-oriented principles such as inheritance and polymorphism.
- [System Design](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/system-design/system-design-tutorial/): Scalable system design concepts, components, and interview-oriented topics.
- [Software Engineering](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/software-engineering/): SDLC, design principles, testing, and engineering process topics.
- [Compiler Design](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/compiler-design-tutorials/): Lexical analysis, parsing, optimization, and compiler phases.
- [Theory of Computation](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/theory-of-computation-automata-tutorials/): Automata, formal languages, and computability fundamentals.

## AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science
- [Machine Learning](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/): ML concepts, algorithms, workflows, and practical learning articles.
- [Data Science for Beginners](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/data-science/data-science-for-beginners/): Introductory data science concepts, tools, and learning path guidance.
- [Artificial Intelligence Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/artificial-intelligence/): AI fundamentals, search, reasoning, and intelligent systems topics.
- [Deep Learning Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/deep-learning-tutorial/): Neural networks, deep learning models, and training concepts.
- [Pandas Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-pandas-tutorial/): Data manipulation and analysis using the Pandas library.
- [NumPy Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/numpy-tutorial/): Numerical computing basics with arrays and vectorized operations.
- [Data Analysis Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/data-analysis-tutorial/): Data cleaning, exploration, and analysis workflows for beginners.
- [Natural Language Processing](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/natural-language-processing-nlp-tutorial/): NLP concepts, preprocessing, and language modeling basics.

## Interview Preparation and Practice

- [Company Preparation](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/company-preparation/): Company-specific interview questions and preparation material.
- [Top 50 Array Problems](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/top-50-array-coding-problems-for-interviews/): Frequently asked array interview problems with explanations.
- [Top 50 String Problems](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/top-50-string-coding-problems-for-interviews/): Common string interview questions and solution approaches.
- [Must Do Coding Questions](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/must-do-coding-questions-for-companies-like-amazon-microsoft-adobe/): High-priority coding questions for major tech company preparation.
- [Practice Problems](https://practice.geeksforgeeks.org/explore?page=1&sortBy=submissions): Problem archive for coding practice across difficulty levels.
- [Contests](https://practice.geeksforgeeks.org/contest): Competitive programming contests and timed coding events.
- [Interview Experiences](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/company-interview-corner/): Real interview experiences from candidates across companies.

## Articles and Community
- [Articles](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/articles/): Broad collection of technical articles across domains and difficulty levels.
- [Tutorials](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/tutorials/): Organized tutorial index for programming and computer science topics.
- [Write an Article](https://write.geeksforgeeks.org/): Contributor portal for submitting technical articles to GeeksforGeeks.
- [GBlog](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/): Blog-style updates, announcements, and community-oriented posts.
- [School Learning](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/school-learning/): Foundational learning resources for school-level computer science topics.
